description: Modern, high-performance .NET 10 wrapper for GDAL/OGR/OSR (GDAL 3.13): raster & vector I/O for 200+ formats, reprojection, warping, DEM analysis, band math (NDVI/NDWI), vector geoprocessing, OGR SQL, VRT, cloud virtual file systems, multidimensional arrays and the GDAL utility suite (gdalinfo, gdal_translate, gdalwarp, ogr2ogr, ...). Native GDAL binaries included. Rust-accelerated kernels. Created by Gravicode Studios, led by Kang Fadhil.
title: GDAL.Net
